name: 2 Days and 1 Night
description: 2 Days & 1 Night is a South Korean reality-variety show with the motto "real wild road variety." Its main concept is to recommend various places of interest that viewers can visit in South Korea.

videos.title: Ulleungdo, North Gyeongsang (1)
videos.overview:
Teddy Bear Delivery Race

This trip is an upgraded delivery race. However for this mission, every member has the same item (a really cute big white teddy bear) to be delivered to Ulleungdo. The first member who arrives in Ulleungdo with his teddy bear safely (hasn't been taken away from him for the duration of the trip) wins sleeping inside and he can choose one other member to sleep inside.

videos.title: Seogwipo, Jeju-do (1)
videos.overview:
Jejudo & Gapado

Trip Theme: Humanism - Spring Special

It's always a given that if the members were given big allowance and/or free buffet, there would be a catch. On this trip, they would have to accomplish the given three photo missions, send the photos to the producer and reach the top of Songaksan before 3PM. If they failed, for the next trip they would have to start shooting at 12:01Midnight. If they could make it, next trip's opening would be at 12:01PM. To make things difficult for them, they had been left behind by the staffs. So they had to bring the cameras left behind by the PD team and shoot themselves.

videos.title: Namhae, Gyeongsangnam-do (2)
videos.overview:
Namhae, Gyeongsangnam-do

Individual Mission. One mission = one ingredient. The harder the mission = more rewarding ingredient. Even though this was an individual mission, however, they would get to eat as a group.  Kang Ho Dong: Glue 100 teddy bear eyes  Uhm Tae Woong: Bow 108 times on top of the famous mountain in Namhae  Lee Su Guen: Find a karaoke machine in town, sing a song and score exactly 79 points  Eun Ji Won: Find a tetris arcade in town, and score the highest score on that machine  Kim Jong Min: Find Chul-soo's house (which is the house where Fantasy Couple drama was filmed), order jajangmyun (which is a black bean noodle) and eat the noodle there  Lee Seung Gi: Put 10 corn shape chips on 10 fingers and eat them all under 5 seconds

CF Promotion Fall Trip (1)
videos.overview: The members go on a trip to enjoy the beautiful fall. They also have to do a drawing competition. Who will be the winner? Stay tuned for their eccentric art world. The members also get to taste the local specialty chicken and beef. However, only three get the grand opportunity. Who will be the winner of the fall trip commercial? Who has what it takes to show all the charms of fall trip?

videos.title: CF Promotion Fall Trip (2)
videos.overview: The members compete one another for some romantic acting with an actress. A special date awaits for the lucky winner. Will the winner be able to win the actress' heart as well? They also play different games to win dinner. Losers get the opportunity to shoot the ending scene of the commercial. Lastly, the commercial will finally be revealed.

videos.title: Best Autumn Meals #2 (1)
videos.overview: The members try to recreate the best fall cuisine they ever tasted throughout the season. They have to acquire the best golden recipe. Who will be the winner of this cooking competition? They have to play yet another game to gain better ingredients. What will be the high-quality ingredient? Also, there is a special chef who is here to help them. Who will it be?

videos.title: Best Autumn Meals #2 (2) + Kim Joo Hyuk Memorial Film Festival
videos.overview:
• Location(s): Muan, Jeollanam-do; Yangsan, Gyeongsangnam-do

• Special appearance by chef Sam Kim

• The dinner was dedicated to Kim Joohyuk a year after his passing. A photowall was created and featured some of Joohyuk's favorite food from the show.

• By the morning, they visited Kim Joo-hyuk's grave and paid their respects.

• After the main trip, a snippet from Kim Joo-hyuk Memorial Film Festival that was held on October 28, 2018 was shown.

videos.title: Enjoying the Fall Colors (1)
videos.overview: The members visit Mount Gyeryong in Gongju to enjoy the fall colors. When they arrive at the temple, the members choose who they trust and depend on the most. Afterward, they start to pair up and hike while one person covers their eyes and relies on the other to lead them.

videos.title: Enjoying the Fall Colors (2)
videos.overview: The members play a spartan-like game to choose who will eat the dinner made from seafood and sleep inside. One person from the losing team has to sleep in a hammock instead of a tent. Meanwhile, the members go to the ocean for their first dive of the winter.

videos.title: The Jeonju Live (1)
videos.overview: Comedian/singer Lee Youngjin, and Youtubers "Hey Jini" and "Oliver Teacher" guest in this episode as they collaborate with the members to create a livestream in an effort for the members to learn more about "new culture."

videos.title: The Jeonju Live (2)
videos.overview: The members try their best to attract more viewers to their channels. Finally, the winner of the Jeonju Live is announced. For this week's "Sleeping Indoors or Outdoors," the members compete in "Mini Olympics."

videos.title: The Jeonju Live (3) / Dream in Your 40s (1)
videos.overview: The members finally decide on the person to sleep outdoors through "Mini Olympics." The next day, the members are faced with various missions. Then, the members share theirs dreams in their 40s and start making their dreams come true.

videos.title: Dream in Your 40s (2)
videos.overview: With the help from Siyoon and Joonyoung, Jongmin tries hard to realize his dream to become a cafe owner. Meanwhile, Taehyun meets with prominent music producers to get a new song for HONGCHA's new album. Junho, who has surprised the members with his strange dream, finally reveals his real dream.

videos.title: Dream in Your 40s (3)
videos.overview: The members divide into teams to play a game to decide who sleeps outdoors, while Junho and the trainees are put in risk of sleeping in refrigerator boxes. Meanwhile, the team that sleeps in the boxes wake up to the first snow.

videos.title: Yellowtail Fish Fishing Race (1)
videos.overview: The members go to Jeju Island to fish the Yellowtail Fish. Once they arrive in Jeju Island, they receive a new mission from Yongjin. Meanwhile, the members go off to find Yongjin.

videos.title: Yellowtail Fish Fishing Race (2)
videos.overview: Yongjin, who was caught by the members play the dinner game with the team. The one who picks the correct person that receives the award can eat the delicious dishes of Jeju Island. Meanwhile, they choose the member to go fishing for the Yellowtail Fish with the Yellowtail Fairy.

videos.title: Gangwon Noodle Trip (1)
videos.overview: The members set out to find the best hot and cold noodle dishes of the Gangwon Province. Little do they know, however, that they must complete missions before they can taste the local noodle delicacies.

videos.title: Gangwon Noodle Trip (2)
videos.overview: The members present their findings to special guests food researcher Lee Hyejeong, restaurateur Hong Seokcheon, and Lee Wookjeong PD. They also determine who will make the first dive of 2019.

videos.title: Winter Vacation Special with the Cha Siblings (1)
videos.overview: The members are visited by three very special guests. The Cha siblings enjoy a fun winter vacation with the members.

videos.title: Winter Vacation Special with the Cha Siblings (2)
videos.overview: Along with magician Choi Hyunwoo, the siblings and the members play the dinner game. After the siblings go to bed, the members properly engage in a competition to spend the night indoors.

videos.title: A Report on Human Greed (1)
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to the cast, the staff keep track on the cast's greed in various situations, such as in appetite and making others laugh. The members who have the most greed are "cleansed!" Guest stars include Hong Kyungmin, Samuel Kim, and Koyote.

videos.title: A Report on Human Greed (2)
videos.overview: The members go on a hard training to find out the end of human greed. The Dinner Game requires a special competition, as the dinner is much more special than usual. The fierce competition is on for the extraordinary supper! The members also get a special break time, but they are suspicious about the staff.

Hoon-Min War (3) / Lunar New Year Special 'Age is Just a Number of Rice Cake Soup' (1)
videos.overview:
Location: Yeongwol, Gangwon-do / Gochang, Jeollabuk-do

For the morning and getting-off-work mission, the members must melt a block of ice and obtain a ticket in it. For the next trip, they head to Gochang. They all become zero-year-olds, and those who complete more missions will gain more years. The members who gain the most years will get to sleep indoors that night.

videos.title: Lunar New Year Special 'Age is Just a Number of Rice Cake Soup' (2)
videos.overview:
Location: Gochang, Jeollabuk-do.

The rice cake soup race continues. The members go through various missions, such as taking a selfie with sheep, singing in front of an unusual audience, and coming up with four-letter idioms from the titles of books. The losers of this race will have to sleep outdoors. Jong Min falls behind the others, but he's given a chance to turn the tables. Who will be the losers of this race?

videos.title: Lunar New Year Special 'Age is Just a Number of Rice Cake Soup' (3)
videos.overview:
Location: Gochang, Jeollabuk-do

The members are given identity tags that they must hide within the base camp. The first three to be found will have to go to a laver farm where they must harvest 30,000 sheets of laver. The members search every nook and cranny to avoid getting the penalty. Who will lose in the game and end up in the laver farm?

videos.title: Traveling in Seoul, "Protect Your Heritage" (1)
videos.overview:
Location: Changdeokgung Palace, Seoul

The members gather in Seoul for the first time in a long while. They divide into teams of two to complete missions in various parts of the city. Their first mission is to find the pieces of a puzzle scattered all over the palaces. At Changdeokgung Palace, they must play a game with a special guest to win a puzzle piece. Which team will obtain all the pieces first and win first place? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Traveling in Seoul, "Protect Your Heritage" (2)
videos.overview: After completing the puzzle successfully, the winning team enjoys the complete meal of Seoul. Later, an individual mission is given to each member, and if they succeed, they get to go home straight without having to spend the night. However, if they fail, they must stay with the staff members and spend the night. Who will succeed in the mission and get off work first? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Minimalism Trip (1)
videos.overview:
Location: Taean, South Chungcheong

For this week's trip, the members are given a chance to bond with one another by going on a retreat to Taean. They're allowed to use the items they brought in their suitcases. On top of that, they get to use the items from the show's prop truck. However, if they fail in the missions, they will have to give up on their items and survive with only the remaining ones.

videos.title: Minimalism Trip (2)
videos.overview:
Location: Taean, South Chungcheong

For the next mission, the members must escape from the maze with zombies roaming around. They must complete the mission not to lose their stuff. Then they move to the beautiful beaches of Taean where they must take pictures of the sunset. At the base camp, they play a game with jjamppong and oysters on the line. Will they get lucky and be able to beat all the staff members? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Minimalism Trip (3) / Youth Trip (1)
videos.overview: Location: Taean, South Chungcheong / Namhae, South Gyeongsang

videos.title: Youth Trip (2)
videos.overview:
Location: Namhae, South Gyeongsang

After winning the bingo game, Team Wannabe Youth is on a roll. Thanks to the ten-minute head start, they successfully finish the next mission before Team Youth. However, with their young spirit and determination, Team Youth catches up fast. The last mission is to find a hidden treasure on Sa Island. Which team will be the final winner? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Youth Trip (3)
videos.overview:
Location: Namhae, South Gyeongsang

After an intense game of Sleeping Indoors or Outdoors, the members wake up to an even more difficult morning mission. They must become part-timers and deliver certain items to different houses in the German Village. Then they head to the popular photo spot of Namhae to take a photo with the pose told by the staff. Will they successfully finish all the missions?

videos.title: Find the Rice Thieves (1)
videos.overview:
Location: Gwangyang, South Jeolla

The members must complete several missions to catch two rice thieves among themselves. The rice thieves confuse the members by playing innocent and blaming others. Seon-ho gets suspected as a rice thief, so he must prove to the others that he's innocent. If the members fail to catch the rice thieves until the last mission, the rice thieves will get to enjoy a complete meal of Gwangyang-style bulgogi.

videos.title: Find the Rice Thieves (2)
videos.overview:
Location: Gwangyang, South Jeolla

For Sleeping Indoors or Outdoors, the members participate in Physical: BACK, where they try various tests to see who the weakest is. They must gain 100 points first through various physical activities to be able to sleep indoors. For the morning mission, they must run a marathon and complete seven missions prepared in the course. The winner gets a complete meal of freshwater clams, Gwangyang's specialty.
